challenge.method: Checked the structured identifier against the filename and comment, then tested the version condition and each feature condition against four hypothetical notices.
challenge.results: A 1.3-only notice with zero Invariant Sections and a Back-Cover Text fails the back-cover condition even if there is no Front-Cover Text. A 1.3-only notice establishing all three absences fits. An unavailable notice leaves the version and feature choices unverified. An or-later grant fails the edition-only condition even when all three features are absent. The suffix reversal is a genuine spelling conflict, resolved by the structured identifier and matching filename.

limitations: The name abbreviates the feature condition. Zero Invariant Sections alone is insufficient.
The explanatory comment spells the key GFDL-1.3-only-no-invariants. The filename GFDL-1.3-no-invariants-only.json and the ListedLicense spdxId agree on the canonical order.
The crosswalk describes the pinned SPDX release. Applying it to a work requires evidence of that work's actual authorization.
